t: The individual serving in the position of Administrator of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration as of the date of the enactment of this Act comes from civilian life and is therefore eligible to serve in such position, in conformance with section 202 of the National Aeronautics and Space Act of 1958 (42 U.S.C. 2472(a)).

fable.w: This provision only declares that the sitting NASA Administrator comes from civilian life and is therefore eligible to hold the office. The phrase "comes from civilian life" might suggest an outside party, but the Administrator is a federal official, and nothing here involves consultation, comment, hearings, advisory bodies, or a right to sue. No party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision.
fable.s: comes from civilian life and is therefore eligible to serve in such position
